rules.title: Ladakh: no permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: Indian citizens carry identity proof and the fee receipt instead of a permit. A few border villages stay closed. The order itself was not found; news reports it.
rules.set_by: Home Department, Union Territory of Ladakh

rules.title: Ladakh: tourist fee paid online, receipt carried
rules.detail: One payment covers an environment fee, a Red Cross contribution and a wildlife fee. The official portal does not show the amounts on its landing page.

rules.title: Ladakh: foreign citizens need a Protected Area Permit
rules.detail: Needed for Nubra, Pangong, Tso Moriri and similar areas beyond Leh. Some nationalities and passport types must apply to central ministries instead.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs; issued through Leh district administration

history.change: Permit kept for foreigners when it was dropped for Indian citizens.

rules.title: Ladakh: rental motorcycles from outside are turned back
rules.detail: Outside rentals may reach Leh but not tour Nubra, Pangong or Hanle. Enforced by the local rental cooperative; no government order found. Own motorcycles are fine with papers.
rules.applies_to: Riders on motorcycles rented outside Ladakh
rules.set_by: Local motorcycle rental associations in Leh (no government order found)

rules.title: Leh: 48 hours of acclimatisation before going higher
rules.detail: Tourists arriving in Leh are told to rest two days before heading to places such as Khardung La and Pangong. No enforcement method was found.

rules.title: Receipt checked at South Pullu before Khardung La
rules.detail: An operator guide says papers are stamped at South Pullu on the way into Nubra. Carry printed copies of the receipt and identity proof. No order found.

rules.title: Khardung La traffic hours: sources disagree
rules.detail: One operator page gives 09:00 to 13:00 outbound from Leh and 13:00 to 17:00 back. Another says the pass has no fixed hours. No official order found.

rules.title: Army verification on the road to Turtuk
rules.detail: Identity and receipts are verified at an army post after the bridge over the Shyok near Chalunka. No written order found.

rules.title: Foreign citizens beyond Hunder: sources disagree
rules.detail: One guide lists Turtuk as open to foreigners holding the Protected Area Permit; another page by the same author warns of restrictions beyond Hunder. No official source found.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs; Leh district administration

season.note: Khardung La has no fixed winter closure; it shuts for a day or more after heavy snow, so there are no yearly opening and closing dates to record.

hazards.title: Slush, potholes and washouts on Khardung La
hazards.detail: Melt and rain break up the surface near the top in high summer.

source.title: Khardung La 2026: Honest Guide to Altitude, Permit, Crossing

hazards.title: Ice and snow closures on Khardung La
hazards.detail: The pass usually reopens within a day or two of heavy snow, but storms have shut it for three to five days.

source.title: Khardung La 2026: Honest Guide to Altitude, Permit, Crossing

hazards.title: Unpaved stretch between South Pullu and North Pullu
hazards.detail: Dirt, loose rock and puddles across the top section of the pass.

hazards.title: Avalanches, rockfall and single-lane delays on Khardung La
hazards.detail: Narrow one-lane sections cause long hold-ups, and the road is prone to washouts, avalanches and falling rocks.

hazards.title: Landslides and Shyok flooding towards Turtuk
hazards.detail: Sections along the Shyok are landslide-prone in the rainy months and the river can flood.

hazards.title: Loose gravel on the final approach to Turtuk
hazards.detail: The last stretch is narrow with loose gravel.

hazards.title: No fuel beyond Diskit
hazards.detail: Diskit has the last pump; there is none onward to Hunder and Turtuk.

hazards.title: Prepaid mobile connections from other states do not work
hazards.detail: A blogger reports that only postpaid connections from outside work in Jammu and Kashmir and in Ladakh; no official source was found.

gaps: No yearly opening or closing dates exist for Khardung La; no dated closure orders were found for the last five years.
No official order found for any traffic hours on Khardung La; two operator pages contradict each other.
Whether tourists may go beyond Turtuk to Tyakshi and Thang was not established; a 2021 news report expected Thang to stay closed, later pages describe it as visited.
Whether foreign citizens may go beyond Hunder to Turtuk is contradicted within one blogger's own pages.
The signboard at Khardung La shows a higher altitude than the measured 17,580 feet (5,359 metres); the measured figure is used.
No government order found for the restriction on rental motorcycles from outside Ladakh.
No official page states the Ladakh tourist fee amounts, so they are left out.
The Ladakh order of August 2021 that dropped the permit for Indian citizens was not found; only news reports of it.
No road number found for the Leh to Nubra road.
Only one recent rider video found; it gives no filming date and was published on 10 July 2026. It shows the rider at Thang, beyond Turtuk.

pumps_from_companies.why: The open map had no pump between Leh and Diskit; IndianOil lists one at Khalsar. These are from the oil companies' own locators, IndianOil's (locator.iocl.com) and HP's (petrolpump.hpretail.in), read on 6 October 2026 for the districts the road runs through. A pump within 5 km along the road of one already on the map is left out. Bharat Petroleum's locator did not answer, and other companies' pumps are not added.

source.title: IndianOil locator: Nubra Valley Filling Station, Khalsar
